title: 10% off Blu-Ray, CDs, Books + Sales + $7.99 Flat Shipping @ Rarewaves
body:
Deal: 10% off Blu-Ray, CDs, Books + Sales + $7.99 Flat Shipping @ Rarewaves

[Gazza-75] Had a look at their 4k titles, not that cheap tbh.
[Phanatic] Agree. You can do much better during JB sales for 4K, so I didn't really highlight them, and the prices for Steelbooks/collector editions are ludicrous. I find Blu-Ray and CDs are 90% more likely to be cheaper at Rarewaves (if they're even still available at JB). I usually make my selection by what's on sale I'm interested in, rather than going for specific titles.
[mrwak] If you collect the Radiance label, note that shipping will usually be cheaper via Rarewaves
[QuickToThePointless] rarewaves all over ebay, prices are competitive…cheaper on there?
[Phanatic] For one-off purchases probably - eBay prices are always a few dollars more than the base price listed on the website, but eBay includes shipping so it might be $4-5 cheaper via eBay for a single title if you factor in the $7.99 flat rate.
However, I think it's always cheaper if you're buying 2+ titles with the 10% off. I don't think I've ever seen an eBay sale for Rarewaves.
Edit: Actually by comparison, of the list above eBay Rarewaves prices:
Portrait of a Lady On Fire - $20.94 vs $13.50
Poor Things - $22.26 vs $14.40
Anomalisa - $20.94 vs $13.50
So 50c more for a one-off, and $7.50 cheaper per title for multiples.
[sa nick] Yeah, a good chunk of my movie and music collection has come from rarewaves eBay store. They're almost always the cheapest and stock so many films other places don't.
[QuickToThePointless] yep - often when ebay throws a $5/10/20 voucher at me , i dont need anything so default is a new CD
[Phanatic] I used to to this a lot, but when they changed the $5 a month eBay Plus to Plus Items only with $50 minimum that stopped.
[TheGman101] Yeah that was one of the reasons I ended the membership!
[2046smh] Nice, never heard of rarewaves. Any other similar online stores for boutique blurays/4k with decent prices?
[127odosbucket] Not a fan.
Tried twice to buy through them for an item(s) that were 'in stock'.
First time buying…. No word from them, delays in shipping, unable to get an answer from customer service. Eventually 11 months later I get an email to say that the item isn't actually in stock and I will get a full refund. I was willing to wait, I really wanted the item (and it wasn't a big cost: $40).
Bit unprofessional but stuff happens. So I thought I would buy something else a bit later. Same issues.
So I'd never tempt fate a third time with these guys. Wouldn't recommend.
[Phanatic] Wow, that's surprising. I've had the opposite experience with customer service - last month I made a purchase and realised I forgot to add something to my cart. I wrote to them and asked if they could add to my order, which they couldn't do, but said if I put another order through and let them know they'd refund the postage, which they did.
This time I accidentally put through a $10 CD three times, noticed within half an hour, wrote to them, and they cancelled and refunded the extra two.
Both times they got back within an hour. I've probably put through 7-10 BIG orders with them (6-20 items each) - never had a problem with out of stock. It sounds like you were super unlucky, but makes sense you wouldn't want to try a third time!
[Dienk] Got items from them few times. Great for Games
[brotherfranciz] Whoa, thanks mate! Some super rare items available at reasonable prices (given their rarity)! How have I never heard of this site before?!
[ocdgamer] Heads up if you're planning a bulk order. They ship it as multiple smaller packages rather than one larger one, apparently because it's cheaper and faster for international delivery.
Was a bit of a headache for me as Auspost almost always redirects my international mail back to the post office
[BenTheBargainer2013] I find wowhd with the buy 3 or more discount that comes up every now and then to be best for best pricing on imported physical media
[Phanatic] Oooh, never heard of them before. Love additional options. What kind of discounts?
[The Value] Their video games are pretty cheap. Comparable to Play-asia for European versions.
[booyeahh] Been buying all my Blu-Rays and music albums from them over the years delivered to Melbourne.
Only downside is no tracking items but it’s fair compromise with their cheaper items.
No dramas with them and they have been helpful with refunds/redelivery of items when it goes missing
